title: DeepHL identified group-specific movement features in animal trajectories
summary: DeepHL highlighted movement segments that distinguish animal groups. In the mouse comparison, a derived maximum straight-line distance in a ±60-second window had information gain 0.287, compared with 0.269 for ambulation speed and 0.184 for fine-movement speed; the paper also reports group-specific features in other animal datasets. These are bounded animal-data analyses, not human findings.

evidence.tested: Features were evaluated on the study datasets; the mouse movement-feature classification accuracy was 74.7%. No independent replication is reported.
evidence.unknown: No independent, prospective or clinical-impact evaluation is reported unless specified in the tested field.
evidence.ai_role: DeepHL highlights discriminative trajectory segments and features, which researchers used to derive and compare behavioral measures.

source_review.scope: Read the original full text, including author affiliations, Methods and Results; checked the first result-bearing version and active/archive catalog for same-result records.
